description: This file defines the WorkflowAddForm class, a Drupal form class for creating new workflows, including form construction, saving logic, and entity property assignment.

classes.name: WorkflowAddForm
classes.description: A form class for adding workflows in Drupal, extending EntityForm and managing workflow creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the workflow type plugin manager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the form with the plugin manager from the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the workflow creation form with fields for label, id, and workflow type.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the workflow entity and redirects based on whether the workflow has states.

methods.name: copyFormValuesToEntity
methods.description: Copies form input values to the workflow entity's properties.
